name: nai-rice
description: Character emotion image studio using NovelAI Reference Inpainting
author: NAI RICE contributors

scripts.dev: npm run build:electron && concurrently -k "vite --config vite.renderer.config.ts" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:electron && vite build --config vite.renderer.config.ts
scripts.package:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis portable && npm run checksums
scripts.package:portable: npm run build && electron-builder --win portable && npm run checksums
